description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage personal AI assistant company as a founding backend engineer. You will own the reliable infrastructure behind an AI agent that communicates through text, email, and phone, shaping the systems and engineering practices that support its growth.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and operate messaging pipelines across text, email, and phone, with reliable ordering, retries, and delivery tracking.

 - Build agent runtimes for background tasks that handle concurrency, timeouts, cancellation, and recovery from model or tool failures.

 - Develop dependable scheduling for future actions, including reminders and follow-ups that respect time zones.

 - Plan capacity, load test, optimize databases, and evolve architecture to address bottlenecks and support growth.

 - Manage data security and privacy through encrypted credentials, Postgres schemas and migrations, and deletion workflows.

 - Build observability and tracing to track latency and costs across messages, models, and tools.

 - Set backend engineering standards and help recruit and mentor future engineers.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 4 years of software engineering experience, including substantial on-call ownership of production systems handling meaningful traffic.

 - Deep distributed systems experience with queues, workers, retries, idempotency, and production failure modes, plus a track record scaling systems through rapid growth.

 - Production experience with Postgres, including schema design, migrations, and performance tuning, as well as cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, and capacity planning.

 - Experience shipping production software in TypeScript or Python and building messaging or event-driven systems where dropped or duplicated events are costly.

 - Experience with observability and tracing across distributed components, and the ability to verify and own code produced with AI-assisted development tools.

 - Agent runtime or reliable scheduling experience is valuable, as is a hands-on founding-team approach to engineering and hiring.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco.
